entities.name: East Slavic Tribes
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The East Slavic tribal unions (Poliane, Slovene, Drevliane, Krivichi, Vyatichi) settled the river basins of the Dnieper, Oka, and Volga. Agricultural communities, pagan beliefs (Perun, Veles), and early fortified settlements.
